name: RC-B10-0545/2025 – After recital B – Am 1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the EU position on the proposed plan and EU engagement towards a just and lasting peace for Ukraine
part_text: B. whereas on 10 November 2025, the National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine (NABU) and the Specialized Anti-Corruption Prosecutor’s Office (SAPO) carried out dozens of raids as part of an investigation into a large-scale corruption scandal in Ukraine’s strategic energy sector, where NABU confirmed it had found evidence of kickbacks and alleged money laundering amounting to USD 100 million, and whereas these revelations expose serious risks to the integrity of Ukraine’s governance and to the oversight of European aid;
